collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: An old net-maker finds a former student has a better knot: learn it, or keep their own way.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) learned net-making from (subject) years ago. Now (friend.he/she) has invented a knot that holds better and ties faster than (subject)'s. Everyone is using it. (subject) has noticed. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) goes to (friend) and asks to be shown. (friend) is so surprised (friend.he/she) ties it wrong twice. Then they sit together all afternoon, master and student swapping places. (subject) says it is the best afternoon (subject.he/she) has had in years.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) keeps (subject.his/her) old knot. (subject.His/her) nets are fine. (friend) never says a word about it. But at (subject)'s next birthday, (friend) gives (subject.him/her) a net tied with both knots, side by side.
